facts.raw_span: a 17-year history of migraine headaches
a visual aura of gray-white spots followed by pain behind the right eye radiating to the right frontal, temporal, and suboccipital regions
3 to 4 severe migraines per month lasting 3 to 7 days
relief only from sumatriptan after trials of acetaminophen, ibuprofen, rizatriptan, methylprednisolone, prednisone, and dexamethasone failed
a right orbital and medial cheek headache radiating to the right lateral jaw, ear, and down the right suboccipital region
treatment with ketorolac, rizatriptan, and a 7-day dexamethasone taper failed to resolve her symptoms
naratriptan, prochlorperazine, acetaminophen, ibuprofen, and diphenhydramine without improvement
Brain magnetic resonance imaging was unremarkable
an ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block with 4 mL of bupivacaine 0.25% and 1 mL of dexamethasone 4 mg/mL
this treatment also failed to resolve her symptoms

concepts.why: The patient has a 17-year history of migraine headaches and experiences a visual aura of gray-white spots followed by pain behind the right eye radiating to the right frontal, temporal, and suboccipital regions.
The patient has a 17-year history of migraine headaches and experiences 3 to 4 severe migraines per month lasting 3 to 7 days.
The patient experiences prolonged and severe migraine attacks that are refractory to treatment.
The patient experiences a continuous headache on one side of the head that is refractory to treatment.
The patient experiences a headache that is characterized by autonomic features and is refractory to treatment.
The patient experiences a persistent headache that is refractory to treatment and has a normal brain MRI.
The patient experiences a headache that is refractory to treatment and has a history of frequent medication use.
The patient experiences a headache that is characterized by pain in the occipital region and is refractory to treatment.
The patient experiences a headache that is refractory to treatment and has undergone an ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block.

The patient's symptoms of a right orbital and medial cheek headache radiating to the right lateral jaw, ear, and down the right suboccipital region, which were unresponsive to various treatments, are consistent with cluster headache, and the unremarkable brain magnetic resonance imaging rules out other possible causes.

rationales.F01: The patient's 17-year history of migraine headaches suggests a chronic condition, making C01 and C02 more likely.
rationales.F02: The visual aura of gray-white spots followed by pain behind the right eye is a classic symptom of migraine with aura, making C01 more likely.
rationales.F05: The right orbital and medial cheek headache radiating to the right lateral jaw, ear, and down the right suboccipital region is consistent with hemicrania continua or trigeminal autonomic cephalalgia, making C04 and C05 more likely.
rationales.F09: The use of an ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block suggests sphenopalatine ganglion neuralgia, making C09 more likely.

frontier_selector.rationale: The patient's history of severe migraines lasting 3 to 7 days, frequency of 3 to 4 per month, and lack of relief from various treatments support Status migrainosus, with Migraine with aura being a close runner-up due to the presence of a visual aura.
